# PageBreak

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Forces subsequent content to begin on a new page.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PageBreak(options?: PageBreakOptions)
```

## Methods

- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Asks for a new page unless the cursor is already at the top of one, then reports completion.
- [`resetState`](#resetstate): Rearms the break so it can trigger again on the next render.
